page.notes: Bottom left has a small mark ("1" or a signature-like sign) that is too faint to read, so it is not transcribed. The left-edge and right-edge fragments belong to adjoining pages. Doubtful readings: "Eoni" in the line "Dii natura Eoni fuerunt" is smudged and may read differently; "Diffamant" may be "diffundant" or similar. The final word of the last line is cut off at the page edge and is marked as a catchword. The Greek-free text has no Hebrew or Greek.
